components.text: The server owns array state. Creation stores the glyph in GlyphChunkStorage and ArrayObject, then activates the center effect. When any bound glyph fails, EndEffect runs before

pages.text:
$(f:minecraft:uniform)register glyphs -> validate interior -> compile AST
                  -> activate center / runtime
canvas edit -> revalidate -> teardown or rebuild$(/f)

• Persistent operations such as LoopOp and ProjectionOp are maintained on server ticks.
• TriggerOp fires one-shot behavior when an event or collision condition is met.
